method: Static proof/control-flow reasoning; counterexamples not executed

findings.title: Empty finite-field evidence accepted as successful determinant certificate
findings.static_counterexample: Start with any certificate passing non-field checks, replace finite_fields with []. The only determinant/root loop is skipped, but the two-root PASS and True remain.
findings.impact: No verified Fourier-rank lower bound remains; graph upper bound alone cannot contradict Fourier feasibility.
findings.archived_data_boundary: Archived certificate contains two entries; no mutation or source execution performed.

findings.title: Mixed-modulus pairing accepts an image-J direction as incompatible
findings.static_counterexample: For otherwise accepted J/G over m=12289 choose nonzero D=J[:,k], i with D_i>0, q=m e_i, P=m²+1, normal_delta_pairing=m D_i. GJ=GD=qJ=0 mod m; qD mod P is the declared nonzero value, although D lies in im J. Taking the prime P=2013265921>m² also works; requiring primality alone is insufficient.
findings.impact: Certificate modulus is trusted for the one pairing but not the rebuilt algebra.
findings.archived_data_boundary: Archived modulus equals12289; the schema diagnoses verifier input acceptance, not corruption of that archived witness.

findings.title: No primality or evidence-count guard
findings.impact: Fermat pivot inversion and prime-field specialization rely on unvalidated input assumptions; literal two-field message is not tied to count/distinctness.

findings.title: Assertions carry mathematical acceptance
findings.impact: Direct optimized execution or inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE can remove substantive checks; unittest wrapper assertions may only test literal success outputs. A parent -O flag alone is not inherited by the runners subprocess command.

findings.title: Empty regression suites may be labeled all-pass
findings.impact: Existing empty directories satisfy the guards and unittest can return0 with no tests. Older runner prints literal29; newer accepts parsed0 and skips.

findings.title: Nonpositive search budget leaves loop index unbound
findings.impact: trials<=0 fails with UnboundLocalError rather than a valid empty-search/rejection result.

findings.title: Finite-field tangent/local curvature scope must survive lifting
findings.impact: Modular rank only supplies a char0 lower bound. Same-dimensional/normal-space or transversality claims need independent structural upper bounds; local specified first lift is not all kernel-shifted lifts.

findings.title: Exception-complete separated encoding is not every quasiseparable stage
findings.impact: Direct generator quadratization covers its entire separated model including zero anchors, but not all QS matrices or an efficient elimination/FFT algorithm. Inverse/open-chart equations retain determinant/anchor restrictions.
